TZE-231 Label Printer Ribbon is a high-quality labeling tape designed for use with Brother P-touch label printers. Measuring 12mm wide and 8 meters long, this tape features black text on a white background, offering excellent readability for both personal and professional labeling tasks. It is ideal for labeling files, cables, shelves, equipment, and more.


Made with laminated material, the TZE-231 tape is durable, water-resistant, fade-resistant, and can withstand harsh conditions including heat, cold, and chemicals—making it suitable for indoor and outdoor use. The easy-peel split back makes application quick and hassle-free.


Key Features:

Tape size: 12mm x 8M

Black on White laminated tape for clear, durable labels

Compatible with a wide range of Brother P-touch label printers

Water, fade, abrasion, and temperature resistant

Ideal for home, office, industrial, or warehouse use
